content.title: Allahumma Salli ‘Ala Muhammad
content.subtitle: 20 Million Durood in 30 Days: The Story of a Blessed Journey!
content.body:
Sallallahu Alaihi Wasallam.

Do you know what has just happened in your life by reciting this one sacred phrase? The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, “Whoever sends one Durood upon me, Allah sends ten blessings upon him, erases ten of his sins from his record, and raises his rank tenfold.”

The Greatest Provision of the Sahabah’s Lives

How deeply the Sahabah understood the virtue of Durood is reflected in an incident involving Ubayy ibn Ka‘b (RA). He asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ how much of his supplication he should dedicate to sending Durood upon him. Gradually increasing the amount, when he said, “I will spend all of my supplication time sending Durood upon you,” the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, “Then it will be sufficient for the removal of all your worries and the forgiveness of all your sins.”

Spreading the Light of Durood from Heart to Heart

In the many busyness of our daily lives, we cannot keep track of how many blessed acts of worship are unknowingly lost. So, how would it be if, even in the midst of the busiest part of your day, the phone in your hand suddenly reminded you of your beloved Prophet ﷺ through a gentle reminder?

This is exactly what the Muslims Day team is working. In the last 30 days, nearly 20 million Durood reminders have reached hundreds of thousands of people through our platform. It is entirely by the infinite mercy of Almighty Allah that He has accepted such a blessed service through us. At the same time, we are immensely grateful to you; your love and encouragement are the main strength behind our journey.

Be a part of this joy too.

However, the sincere effort to encourage such a vast number of people to regularly recite Durood is not carried out by the Muslims Day team alone. Behind the scenes are people who are working as our supporters. They are the Muslims Day Ansars.

It is because of their sincere love and tireless efforts that we have been able to take this service of Deen this far today. Already, 583 Ansars have joined us. Alhamdulillah! But the boundaries of our dream are much wider. We want to have 2,000 dedicated Ansars by our side, with whose support, InshaAllah, this blessed Dawah of Muslims Day can easily reach millions of Muslims across the world.

Just imagine, you may be busy with your work or already asleep at night, while somewhere else in the world, a Muslim sees the reminder and recites Durood, and a share of that good deed is added to your record.

So, let us join this journey of light to carry the love of the Messenger of Allah ﷺ to millions of hearts. By joining Muslims Day as an Ansar in this great service to the Ummah, let us build an everlasting provision for the Hereafter.

I want to become a Muslims Day Ansar! 👉 Click 👉 https://id.kahf.co/ansar/muslimsday

References:

• Jami‘ at-Tirmidhi: Hadith 2457 (The incident of Ubayy ibn Ka‘b (RA) regarding Durood)
